blocks.title: Sc 1 · Mara runs for the ferry
blocks.prompt:
STYLE: Photoreal cinematic live action, shot on 35mm film, natural skin texture, shallow depth of field, vertical 9:16, cold blue dusk against warm tungsten.
SCENE: Harbour Pier [location:Harbour Pier], exterior, dusk; deserted wooden pier, wind whipping sea spray, last blue light, the Ferry [prop:Ferry] idling at the far end with every light blazing.
CAST: Mara [character:Mara], woman in her 60s, wiry, grey-streaked braid, oil-stained work jacket.
SHOT 1 (0-3s): EXTREME WIDE, static, low angle down the pier. The ferry glows at the far end; spray drifts through frame.
SHOT 2 (3-7s): MEDIUM, handheld tracking backwards. Mara hurries down the wet planks towards camera, breath steaming, one fist clenched around the brass locket [prop:Brass locket].
SOUND: Wind gusts, waves slapping the pilings, the ferry's engine idling.

blocks.title: Sc 1 · Last call
blocks.prompt:
STYLE: Photoreal cinematic live action, shot on 35mm film, natural skin texture, shallow depth of field, vertical 9:16, cold blue dusk against warm tungsten.
SCENE: Harbour Pier [location:Harbour Pier], exterior, dusk, wind and spray, the ferry's lights ahead.
CAST: Mara [character:Mara], woman in her 60s, wiry, grey-streaked braid, oil-stained work jacket, fist clenched.
SHOT 1 (0-6s): MEDIUM CLOSE-UP, handheld, Mara still moving towards camera, the ferry lights bright behind her. An off-screen ferryman [voice:Ferryman (voice)] calls (shouting over the wind): "Last crossing! Now or never!" Mara [voice:Mara (voice)] (breathless, pleading): "Wait. Please wait."
SOUND: Wind, waves, the ferry's engine revving.

blocks.title: Sc 2 · The locket
blocks.prompt:
STYLE: Photoreal cinematic live action, shot on 35mm film, natural skin texture, shallow depth of field, vertical 9:16, cold blue dusk against warm tungsten.
SCENE: Ferry Cabin [location:Ferry Cabin], interior, dusk outside; warm tungsten light, rows of empty benches, spray-streaked windows.
CAST: Jonas [character:Jonas], man in his 60s, broad-shouldered, flat cap. Mara [character:Mara], woman in her 60s, wiry, grey-streaked braid, oil-stained work jacket, wind-blown.
SHOT 1 (0-4s): MEDIUM WIDE, static, from behind Jonas seated by the window; Mara appears in the doorway in the background and stops. He turns his head.
SHOT 2 (4-10s): CLOSE-UP on their hands between them. Mara opens her palm: the brass locket [prop:Brass locket]. Jonas takes it and opens it; slow push-in to his face as a slow smile breaks.
SOUND: The engine's low hum, rain-like spray ticking on glass, no music yet.

blocks.title: Sc 2 · You kept it
blocks.prompt:
STYLE: Photoreal cinematic live action, shot on 35mm film, natural skin texture, shallow depth of field, vertical 9:16, cold blue dusk against warm tungsten.
SCENE: Ferry Cabin [location:Ferry Cabin], interior, warm tungsten light, empty benches, the dark pier outside the window.
CAST: Jonas [character:Jonas], man in his 60s, broad-shouldered, flat cap, holding the open locket. Mara [character:Mara], woman in her 60s, wiry, grey-streaked braid, oil-stained work jacket.
SHOT 1 (0-5s): OVER-THE-SHOULDER from behind Mara onto Jonas. Jonas [voice:Jonas (voice)] (quiet, moved): "You kept it." Reverse to Mara, MEDIUM CLOSE-UP. Mara [voice:Mara (voice)] (dry, tender): "Forty years. You're late."
SHOT 2 (5-9s): MEDIUM WIDE, static, both by the window; through the glass the pier lights slide away as the Ferry [prop:Ferry] pulls out.
SOUND: The ferry horn sounds, long and low; engine rising.
